rbi_compensation.text: RBI compensation starts: 85% of a small digital-fraud loss, up to ₹25,000, mostly paid by RBI with the banks; for frauds done with credentials taken from the customer (an OTP, PIN or KYC trick) or payments made under coercion, if reported on cybercrime.gov.in and to the bank within 5 days. Money a person sends willingly after being fooled is not covered.
